title: Boat Momentum
description:
This mod brings back boats momentum after falling off a block.
It's both for client and server.
Useable on ice track.
body:
🛶 Boat Momentum
Boat Momentum is a specialized utility mod designed to improve the fluid movement of boats in Minecraft by preserving their kinetic energy.

✨ Current Features:
Momentum Retention: In vanilla Minecraft, boats often lose speed abruptly when hitting a small ledge or leaving the water. This mod ensures that your movement vector is preserved, allowing for a much smoother and faster sailing experience.

Speed Maintenance: Travel through oceans and rivers without the annoying "speed caps" that occur during minor collisions.

Lightweight & Optimized: Built for NeoForge 1.21.8, the mod is extremely small and won't affect your FPS.

🚀 Why download it?
If you've ever felt that Minecraft boats are too clunky or lose speed too quickly, this mod is for you. It keeps the "flow" of your travel alive, making long-distance maritime exploration rewarding.
